app.vendorCredit: Powered by Smile Artec Dental Laboratory

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your username and password to continue.

password.title: Change password
password.forcedIntro: For the safety of your account, choose a new password before you continue.
password.intro: Saving signs out every open session of this account.

auth.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

setup.title: First-time setup
setup.intro: Enter the owner account and the lab details. You can edit the lab details later in Settings.
setup.usernameHint: Letters, digits and . _ - only, no spaces.
setup.nameHint: Enter the name in Arabic, in English, or both.
setup.currencyHint: Once any amount is recorded, the currency code and decimal places can no longer change.
setup.language: Language of the program and documents
setup.timeZoneHint: Used to decide the lab's today.

validation.usernameFormat: Letters, digits and . _ - only, no spaces.
validation.labNameRequired: Enter the lab name in Arabic or in English.
validation.timeZone: Enter a valid time zone, e.g. Asia/Hebron.
validation.moneyFormat: Enter an amount such as 120 or 120.50.
validation.moneyDecimals_zero: This currency has no decimal places.
validation.moneyNegative: A negative amount is not allowed here.
validation.integerRange: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

network.title: Cannot reach the program
network.body: Make sure the program's service is running on this computer, then try again.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to this page
forbidden.body: Ask the account owner to give you the right permission.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: It may have moved or been removed, or the link is wrong.

stale.title: The data changed somewhere else
stale.body: This data was changed in another window. Reload it, then try again.

route.title: This page could not be shown
route.body: Something unexpected happened. Reload the page; if it happens again, send the reference number to support.

list.activeHint: An inactive item is not offered for new cases and stays in old records.

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.search: Search by name, clinic or phone
doctors.empty: No doctors yet. Add the first one.
doctors.name: Doctor name
doctors.openingBalanceHint: Positive: the doctor owes the lab. Negative (e.g. -50): the lab owes the doctor. Leave empty if none.
doctors.deactivated: The doctor has records, so they were deactivated instead of deleted.
doctors.deleteBody: If the doctor has an opening balance or cases, they are deactivated instead and kept in the records. Otherwise they are deleted together with their special prices.

prices.intro: A special price replaces the general price for this doctor on new case lines only; earlier lines keep their price.
prices.caption: Special prices of {{name}}
prices.removed: {{name}} is back to the general price.
prices.noWorkTypes: There are no work types yet.

workTypes.title: Work types
workTypes.intro: Each work type has a price per tooth. A new price affects new lines only.
workTypes.empty: No work types yet. Add your types and their prices.
workTypes.name: Work type
workTypes.priceNote: A new price affects new lines only; earlier cases keep their price.
workTypes.created: The work type has been added.
workTypes.updated: The work type has been saved.
workTypes.deleted: The work type has been deleted.
workTypes.deactivated: The work type is in use, so it was deactivated instead of deleted.
workTypes.reactivated: The work type is active again.
workTypes.deleteBody: If cases use it, it is deactivated instead. Otherwise it is deleted together with its special prices.

technicians.title: Technicians
technicians.intro: Technicians you can pick on a case.
technicians.name: Technician name
technicians.deactivated: The technician is used by cases, so they were deactivated instead of deleted.
technicians.deleteBody: If used by cases, they are deactivated instead.

expenseCategories.title: Expense categories
expenseCategories.intro: Categories of outgoing payments. The doctor refund category is needed by the system.
expenseCategories.name: Category name
expenseCategories.deactivated: The category is in use, so it was deactivated instead of deleted.
expenseCategories.deleteBody: If it is in use, it is deactivated instead.
expenseCategories.systemHint: This is the system category: it can be renamed only, not deactivated or deleted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.labProfileIntro: Shown on invoices, statements and receipts.
settings.currencyLocked: Amounts have been recorded, so the currency code and decimal places can no longer change (amounts are not converted). Only the symbol can change.
settings.languageIntro: The language of the program for this installation, and of printed documents.
settings.numberingIntro: The first case and invoice numbers. They can change only before the first number is issued.
settings.numberLocked: The first number was issued, so the start cannot change. Next number: {{next}}.
settings.logoIntro: Shown in the sidebar and on documents. Without a logo, only the lab name is shown.
settings.logoHint: A PNG or JPEG image, up to 1 MB. Never shown larger than its own size.
settings.removeLogoBody: Only the lab name will show in the menu and on new documents.
settings.logoInvalidType: The logo must be a PNG or JPEG image.
settings.logoTooLarge: The file is larger than {{max}} MB.
